script_text: Stop everything, Scorpio—Pluto is stirring your subconscious like a storm right now. Mars is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Pluto in your 8th House of shared resources, igniting your Water element with obsession and power. Venus sextiles Neptune in your 4th House of home and family. This powerful aspect activates deep emotional currents and hidden financial dynamics that demand your attention. This is not a day for superficial talk. If you're in a relationship, expect a raw conversation about trust and intimacy that cannot be postponed until tomorrow. If single, you will attract someone mysterious through a joint investment, inheritance, or shared financial matter. The Moon in your 10th House of career opposes Uranus, signaling a sudden professional pivot or an unexpected bonus tied to a partnership. Avoid signing binding contracts before noon under this volatile Mars-Pluto square. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
